subject: Re: Renewal & capacity evaluation — Veridian Health
messages:
From: Alex Green <alex.green@veridianhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@veridianhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal evaluation & proposed bake-off

Hi Mina,

Quick heads-up — the exec team at Veridian has asked us to run a short competitive evaluation before we sign off on the renewal. Orion AI has pitched a lower-latency architecture and a PoC for our inference pipelines.

We value Redwood's stability and the operational tooling you provide, but the board wants a head-to-head on throughput/latency and cost-per-inference across our busiest routes (clinical notes ingestion, triage routing).

Can you send a concise test plan (what you need from our side, expected timeline, and a benchmark template)? Also need an outline of a credible short-term retention offer if we commit to a capacity increase (2x current tokens) while the bake-off runs.

Target timeline: start tests by Sep 6, decision by Sep 24.

Thanks — appreciate a short reply with next steps.

Alex
Alex Green
Head of ML Platforms, Veridian Health
alex.green@veridianhealth.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal evaluation & proposed bake-off

Alex — thanks for the context. We understand the need for a controlled bake-off. Attached is a lightweight PoC checklist and benchmark template (redwood_poc_template.xlsx) that outlines the test harness, required datasets, and metrics we recommend (p95 latency, token-cost, throughput at target concurrency).

High-level plan:
- Sep 6–8: baseline run (your data on your infra)
- Sep 9–13: Redwood-run benchmark against a pinned model (we'll provide a pinned variant that matches your production model size)
- Sep 14–17: comparison report and tuning pass

Retention offer (short-form):
- 3-month extension to current term if Veridian signs an amendment for 2x committed capacity for 6 months
- During the extension: dedicated pool pilot (2x current vGPU capacity) for 30 days at no extra charge so you can validate latency/throughput in production traffic
- SLA uplift: guaranteed p95 latency target or automatic credits (details in formal amendment)

I'll loop in Marissa and Ben to confirm the commercial guardrails. Please share the datasets and a preferred time for an initial kickoff call this week.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal evaluation & proposed bake-off

Mina — quick internal thread on pricing flexibility.

We can offer:
- A one-time retention credit equal to 15% of the next invoice if they sign the 6-month 2x capacity commit.
- Or an alternative: 20% off unit compute for the pilot window (30 days) followed by ramped pricing back to standard commit rates.

Notes: both offers require legal to sign an amendment; 15% credit is easiest (no invoicing churn) but less flexible for operational validation. If Procurement pushes heavily on sticker price, Marissa you have authority to take to 20% full-term on a 12‑month commit.

Also prepared the SLA language for p95 credits; attaching MSA redline separately in the legal thread.

-ben
Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@veridianhealth.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@veridianhealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposal: pilot + amendment to cover bake-off window

Alex — thanks for walking this through with Mina last week. Attached is our benchmark report from the Redwood-run tests and a short-form commercial amendment (MSA_redline_2027.docx). Summary below.

Executive summary from benchmarks (redwood-run):
- Latency: Redwood p95 is ~12% slower than Orion’s best-case on synthetic low-variability payloads, but under production traces our model tuning reduces the gap to ~4% at target concurrency.
- Cost: Redwood cost-per-inference is ~18% higher on raw compute at the same configuration, but our KV caching and prefix strategies reduced observed token cost by ~9% in the Veridian production traces we tested.
- Operational: Redwood delivered <1.5% error rate on structured outputs and full traceability (per-request logs) during the run — this was called out by your engineering team.

Commercial offer to keep Veridian online and give you time for a fair head-to-head:
1) 30-day dedicated pilot: 2x current capacity (no additional charge) to validate real traffic characteristics;
2) 3-month term extension if Veridian signs the amendment for a 6‑month 2x commit within 7 days;
3) Pricing concession: either 15% retention credit on next invoice OR 20% off compute for the pilot window (you choose);
4) SLA uplift during pilot with concrete p95 targets and automatic credits for breaches;

Next steps:
- Approve the amendment and choose pricing concession (credit vs pilot discount).
- Share final dataset endpoints and a primary contact for the pilot (SRE or ML infra).
- We'll send a DocuSign link for the amendment once you confirm.

Attachments: veridian_benchmark_results_v2.pdf, MSA_redline_2027.docx

If this aligns, I'll escalate to Legal and get the DocuSign ready — happy to jump on a 30-min sync tomorrow to walk through the results.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Alex Green <alex.green@veridianhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: pilot + amendment to cover bake-off window

Marissa — thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear summary. The team reviewed the benchmark PDF this morning. Two quick points:

1) We want the dedicated 30-day pilot in prod traffic as described; that directly answers our ops concerns.
2) We'll take the 15% retention credit (keeps invoicing simple) and will sign the amendment for the 6-month 2x commit.

Please go ahead and send the DocuSign link and a calendar invite for pilot kickoff Thursday Sep 23 at 10:00 AM PT. Our SRE lead (Sam Ortiz) will join.

Also please include the PoC checklist Mina sent so Sam can prep endpoints.

Appreciate the quick collaboration — looking forward to validating this.

Best,
Alex
Alex Green
Head of ML Platforms, Veridian Health
alex.green@veridianhealth.com
